name: pmc-wrap-the-week
description: Closes the week into a Weekly Wrap with done against planned, decision records for the log, open loops with owners, next week's top three, and proposed edits to the product context file and project memory for you to approve. Use for "run pmc-wrap-the-week", "wrap my week", "which decisions from this week should go in the log", "what should change in our context file", "Friday close", "plan next week", "Monday starts from zero", part of the Claude Opus 5.5 for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
